column3: “ Designing energy efficiency into our cloud and data center platforms is a critical
part of Intel’s virtuous cycle of growth. Our products help our customers build
high-performing solutions that lower their operating costs and reduce their carbon
footprint. It’s one of our key competitive advantages. Platforms using the recently
introduced Intel® Xeon® processor E5-2600 v4 product family deliver up to 50%
improvement in energy efficiency compared to the previous generation of platforms.1”

column6: Intel Executive Vice President, General Manager, Data Center Group
